transcript.text: Good morning everyone. Let's get started with today's access-coordination meeting. I need to hear from security, facilities, and motor-pool on any changes affecting tomorrow's work parties. As a reminder, tomorrow's routine support schedule includes a communications-calibration team, a water-treatment contractor, and a generator-inspection vehicle. We have East Gate and North Gate for routine vehicle entry, and staging pads A, B, and C available inside the perimeter. I'll publish the binding access and staging plan after this meeting and before tomorrow's first scheduled work party. Please go ahead and report any changes or issues on your end.
transcript.speaker: A1

transcript.text: I need to report a change from security regarding tomorrow's communications-calibration team. Their temporary badges are valid only from 0830 to 0930 tomorrow and can be activated only at East Gate. I received the confirmed badge roster from the visitor-control desk this morning, but it has not yet been added to the access brief. This means the comms-calibration team must enter through East Gate, not North Gate, and their window is tight.

I confirmed with the utilities supervisor today that the scheduled electrical lockout at the plant won't be released until exactly 1130 tomorrow. The contractor cannot enter the plant until after that lockout is released, and they'll need the reserved work period following it. However, our facilities schedule still shows the ordinary morning access window for this contractor, which is incorrect. Maj. Alvarez, the binding access and staging plan needs to reflect the 1130 or later access time for the water-treatment contractor, not the morning window currently on the schedule.
